name: markdown-visualiser
purpose: Drag-and-drop markdown files or folders into a browser and get a typeset, archival-paper reading experience, exportable as PDF or a single self-contained HTML file.

architecture.principle: Exactly one markdown rendering pipeline, running client-side. The server never parses markdown.
architecture.client: Vite + React 19 + TypeScript SPA. Ingest, repair, render, read, and export-serialisation all happen in the browser.
architecture.server: Fastify serving the static SPA plus a stateless Playwright print service. No persistence, no database, no filesystem writes.

AssetRef.path: string  - normalised POSIX relative path, lowercased for lookup
AssetRef.originalPath: string  - as it appeared in the drop
AssetRef.url: string  - blob: URL valid for the session

Heading.id: string  - github-slugger slug, unique within a document

MarkdownDoc.id: string  - stable hash of relative path
MarkdownDoc.path: string  - normalised POSIX relative path from drop root
MarkdownDoc.title: string  - frontmatter.title, else first H1, else prettified filename
MarkdownDoc.order: number | null  - explicit frontmatter order, if present
MarkdownDoc.error: string | null  - per-file failure, does not fail the set

DocumentSet.rootName: string  - dropped folder name, or 'Documents' for loose files

rules: 3. Conventional index names first within a directory: README, index, introduction, overview, 00.
4. Directory depth then directory name, so nested sections stay grouped under their parent.
5. Case-insensitive natural alphabetical on filename as the final tiebreak.
ordering.note: Rules are applied lexicographically as a composite sort key, not as a cascade of comparators, so ordering is stable and testable.

repair.philosophy: Never silently alter the user's document. Every change is recorded as a RepairNote and surfaced in the UI as an inspectable list.

rules.heading-skip: Collapse skipped heading levels (H1 -> H3 becomes H1 -> H2) while preserving relative hierarchy.
rules.duplicate-h1: The first H1 becomes the document title; subsequent H1s are demoted to H2 and everything below shifts accordingly.
rules.list-nesting: Normalise inconsistent indentation to the nearest valid nesting level.
rules.mixed-markers: Unify bullet markers within a single list to the list's dominant marker.
rules.unbalanced-emphasis: Close unterminated emphasis/strong runs at end of block rather than letting them bleed.
rules.trailing-ws: Strip trailing whitespace that is not a deliberate hard line break.

pipeline.invariant: Nothing user-controlled may be introduced after rehype-sanitize. KaTeX, Shiki and Mermaid markup is generated by us, from already-sanitised source, and is therefore trusted.

body.html: string  - complete standalone document, all CSS/fonts/images already inlined as data URIs
body.title: string
body.margin: { top, right, bottom, left } CSS lengths - optional

errors.400: Malformed body or missing html field

errorBehaviour.unparseableFile: Recorded on MarkdownDoc.error; the document appears in the index marked as failed; the rest of the set renders normally.
errorBehaviour.missingImage: Renders a styled placeholder figure naming the missing path; never a broken-image icon.
errorBehaviour.oversizedDrop: Drops over 200 MB total or 2000 files are rejected before processing with a message naming the actual size.
errorBehaviour.unsupportedFile: Recorded in DocumentSet.skipped with a reason; never silently discarded.
errorBehaviour.pdfTimeout: 504 with a message advising export of the standalone HTML instead.
errorBehaviour.noMarkdownFound: Explicit empty-state explaining that no .md or .markdown files were found in the drop.

nonGoals: Themes beyond the archival paper direction
